sentences.text: Mucolipidosis type II and mucolipidosis type III alpha/beta are both recorded as caused by the gene GNPTAB [e_3e25cc51aab5] [e_d96c82796358].
Both gene links are curated, meaning they come from OMIM and Orphanet [e_3e25cc51aab5] [e_d96c82796358].
Constellate also computed that the two conditions have similar symptom profiles, with a score of 0.295 over 38 shared terms, ranked 1 of 1 [e_3933e7531d9c].
That similarity is inferred, meaning Constellate calculated it, and it is not a database finding [e_3933e7531d9c].
Type II has two curated features, restricted chest movement and a protruding belly, both listed as very frequent [e_5ee12535f0b7] [e_2e6faa03a353].

Type III has one completed observational study on ClinicalTrials.gov, a patient group link made by an automatic name match, and a research network grant [e_1149d14e98a6] [e_10cd9c45a3ff] [e_0efb7d0e40d1].
These edges do not show any treatment, and they list no symptoms for type III [e_1149d14e98a6] [e_3933e7531d9c].
